main_text.p: vox oraculo digna. Discamus igitur & nos tandem sapere. Quid enim est, Conferre aliquid in gloriam Dei? Nempe id quod est, Candelæ splendorem soli fœnerari. Nè quis vestrûm me hoc fingere dicat, In Joan. 17. [?]{1}Toletum ve-strum confulat, oro: Deus (inquit) hominem, & homo Deum clarificat, seu glorificat; at multo aliter: nam Deus glorificat hominem ei beneficia conferendo, & bona, quibus efficitur homo gloriosus: at homo nihil potest offerre Deo boni; sed glorificat Deum, cùm præclaram habeat notitiam Dei, & manifestum facit eis qui ignorant. Hæc ille. Addo: In eo quòd istæc no-stra glorificatio grata sit Deo, ejus solius gra-tiæ debetur. Quid porrò? Nostrum quod di-citur Meritum de Congruo, quandoquidem non proficit Deo, non potest non esse ei contu-meliosum: id quod nunc exactius confirmare conamur.

page.notes: Marginal note 1 is in the left margin, beside the word "Toletum"; the printed reference "17." is partly unclear and is marked [?]. Faint marks in the left margin around the middle of the page are show-through and could not be read. The running head also carries "Cap.15." at the right, left out as a number. The text below the rule is show-through from the other side and is not transcribed. The reading "Congruo" in the italic phrase and "contu-" at the line end are clear enough, but the ligature forms in "Meritum" were checked only at normal resolution.
